text_block_list.text: Heading into the Yasuda Kinen with morale at its peak. With the rivalry continuing from the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, the fans are even more hyped up—

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
—We are broadcasting live from
a buzzing Tokyo Racecourse!
Let's go ahead and interview some spectators—

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Everyone,
your outfits are so lovely!
Did you all coordinate for today?

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The Flight-chan we cheer for
is super fashionable, so—

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan A
text_block_list.text:
We, "Flight Cheers,"
have coordinated our outfits based on Flight-chan's racing silks too♪

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: I see! Bringing out each person's individuality while keeping a unified feel... It's really eye-catching!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin Fan A
text_block_list.text: Please check this out tooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you guys are... the "Bakushin Cheering Squad"!
Your matching armbands look so cool!
Bakushin with our hearts as one! ...Right?!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right! I'm not gonna lose to my rival Flight-san, so I'll cheer her on in a super cute outfit too!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"The rivalry between champion Bakushin O and the rapidly rising
Flight has even spread to a fashion showdown among their fans!"

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's excitement has reached a fever pitch!
Just how will this race unfold?!
Let's wait and see with high expectations!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woooow!
You're all fired up! Just like a BBQ!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey! Who is it?!
Today's star of the party is—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Me!? Me!?
Me-me-me-me!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, surprise!
Helios-san!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey! Taiki~ whew!
A super-hyped party ain't complete without me☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, fr fr isn't this insane!?
It was super amazing when me and m'lady did it too, though♡

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Besties are totally here today too, right!?
Gotta hype it up~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Japanese is so difficult!
First, let's go to the paddock, yes!
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what excitement!
It's practically a full-blown festival!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Who's stronger, Flight-san or me?!
Expectations are flying high!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Grand expectations...
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my!
You're all smiles!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Because you have such high expectations of me! It makes me happy."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I completely understand!
Howeeever! The one to answer that call will be m—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: No. Me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
1,600m, my best outfit...
I absolutely will not yield here.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You may be super stylish, but...
Today, I'm the one who's taking the lead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...I am surprised.
To see you make such an expression.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you notice?
I've had... this expression on my face the whole time.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Do you dislike me?
Clad in my pride as I am."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...No!
That pride suits you wonderfully!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me as well! I shall confront this
clad in my class representative pride.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whether in speed or in pride... I will be the one who wins!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for acknowledging me,
Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that...
I feel so much more confident in myself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let us see who is truly worthy of the mile...
with an outfit showdown...!
